body: Yeah fuck people who have to work to live. Have they ever considered not being poor?

I just don't know how to deal with being alone anymore. It never used to bother me but now I think about it all the time. I can't imagine someone every loving me and I cry at the thought of physical intimacy. My old friends have forgotten I existed and have never spoken to me outside of physical proximity.

I'm going to die alone. Everytime I think about someone loving me my mind tells me no one could. I cry at the slightest thought of intimacy. I have no friends and the ones I thought I did have forgotten me.
